props.label: Multi Out Capable
props.description: If True - this workcenter is capable of producing multiple outputs, if false, only 1 output will ever be produced at a time.

props.label: Workcenter History Sync
props.description: Synchronize workcenter history for this machine - only use this, if you are not tracking mode/event changes in Fuuz - for workcenters that are not integrated, or not using any Fuuz screens.

props.label: Production History Sync
props.description: Syncronize Production history for this workcenter - Only use, if you are not reporting production through Fuuz directly or via PLC integration. The use here would be if production / scrap entries are being done in an external system, this boolean is used to indicate you want those records pulled from that external system, into Fuuz for analysis.

props.label: Auto Production
props.description: Enables a user to enable Auto Production for any production Output associated to this workcenter This will be triggered only from PLC Tags where use case is production or scrap. Manual production entries will still be reported regardless of this flag.

props.label: Printer  Device
props.description:
Select the printer device that will be used if auto-printing production labels. 
If no device is selected, no labels will be printed.

props.label: Run Sync
props.description: When True, runs will be able to be synchronized from a 3rd party system. When set to False, all production runs will be initiated only through Fuuz/ or via your PLC integration with Fuuz. The Synch option will not be available to the end user for a given workcenter when this is False.
